get.description: Retrieve all CRM object tags associated with a specific object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view tags that are used to categorize or label CRM objects, which can be useful for organizing and filtering data.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which tags are being retrieved. This parameter is required and must be a string.

post.description: Create a new CRM object tag for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define attributes such as name, color, and filter criteria for the tag. It is useful for organizing and categorizing CRM objects based on custom criteria.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the tag is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve a specific CRM object tag by its unique identifiers. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a tag associated with a particular object type in your HubSpot account. Useful for obtaining tag details for further processing or display.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the tag belongs.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to retrieve.

put.description: Update an existing CRM object tag in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the properties of a specific tag identified by its tag ID and object type ID. It is useful for maintaining and organizing tags associated with CRM objects.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type associated with the tag.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to update.

delete.description: Delete a specific CRM object tag identified by the objectTypeId and tagId. This operation is useful for removing tags that are no longer needed or relevant in your CRM system.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the tag belongs.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the tag to be deleted.

patch.description: Update an existing CRM object tag in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the properties of a tag, such as its name, color, description, and associated filter branches. Use this to keep your tags up-to-date with your CRM data management needs.

parameters.name: tagId

surveyId.description: A string that represents the unique identifier of the SurveyMonkey survey.

surveyQuestion.description: A string that represents the specific question within the SurveyMonkey survey that is being filtered.

valueComparison.description: An object that defines the comparison operation to be used for the survey response value. This can be one of several types of operations, such as boolean, number, string, date-time, and more.

amount.description: An integer specifying the amount of the time unit for the offset.

offsetDirection.description: A string indicating the direction of the time offset. Valid values include 'BEFORE' and 'AFTER'.

timeUnit.description: A string representing the unit of time for the offset, such as 'DAYS', 'HOURS', or 'MINUTES'.

endpointBehavior.description: A string that specifies the behavior of the endpoint in the operation.

includeObjectsWithNoValueSet.description: A boolean indicating whether objects with no value set should be included.

operationType.description: A string indicating the type of operation. The default value is 'TIME_POINT'.

operator.description: A string representing the operator used in the operation.

propertyParser.description: A string indicating the parser used for properties in the operation.

timePoint.description: An object representing the specific time point for the operation. It can be one of several types, such as a date point, indexed time point, or property-referenced time.

type.description: A string representing the type of the operation.

hour.description: An integer representing the hour of the day.

millisecond.description: An integer representing the millisecond within the second.

minute.description: An integer representing the minute within the hour.

referenceType.description: A string indicating the type of reference, which is 'TODAY' by default.

second.description: An integer representing the second within the minute.

coalescingRefineBy.description: An object that specifies criteria for refining the coalescing of events. It can be one of several types, such as PublicNumOccurrencesRefineBy or PublicTimePointOperation.

eventTypeId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the event type.

filterLines.description: An array of PublicEventFilterMetadata objects, each representing a line of filtering criteria.

filterType.description: A string representing the type of filter. The default value is 'UNIFIED_EVENTS'.

pruningRefineBy.description: An object that specifies criteria for refining the pruning of events. It can be one of several types, such as PublicNumOccurrencesRefineBy or PublicTimePointOperation.

coalescingRefineBy.description: An optional refinement criterion that combines multiple conditions into a single result. It can be one of several types, such as 'PublicNumOccurrencesRefineBy', 'PublicSetOccurrencesRefineBy', etc.

eventTypeId.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the event type being filtered.

filterBranchOperator.description: A string representing the logical operator used to combine multiple filter branches.

filterBranchType.description: A string indicating the type of filter branch. Defaults to 'UNIFIED_EVENTS'.

filterBranches.description: An array of nested filter branches, each of which can be of various types such as 'OR', 'AND', 'NOT_ALL', etc.

filters.description: An array of filters that apply specific conditions to the events. Each filter can be of different types, such as property filters, association filters, and more.

operator.description: A string that specifies the operation to be performed on the event type. Valid values include 'HAS_COMPLETED' and 'HAS_NOT_COMPLETED'.

pruningRefineBy.description: An optional refinement criterion used to narrow down results by removing certain conditions. It can be one of several types, such as 'PublicNumOccurrencesRefineBy', 'PublicSetOccurrencesRefineBy', etc.

filterType.description: A string that specifies the type of filter being applied. The default value is 'WEBINAR'.

operator.description: A string representing the operator used in the filter, which defines how the filter criteria should be applied.

webinarId.description: A string that uniquely identifies a webinar within the system.

dayOfWeek.description: A string representing the day of the week. Valid values include 'MONDAY', 'TUESDAY', 'WEDNESDAY', 'THURSDAY', 'FRIDAY', 'SATURDAY', and 'SUNDAY'.

hour.description: An integer representing the hour of the day.

millisecond.description: An integer representing the millisecond within the second.

minute.description: An integer representing the minute within the hour.

referenceType.description: A string indicating the type of reference, which is 'WEEK' for this component.

second.description: An integer representing the second within the minute.

day.description: An integer representing the day of the month.

hour.description: An integer representing the hour component of the time.

millisecond.description: An integer representing the millisecond component of the time.

minute.description: An integer representing the minute component of the time.

month.description: An integer representing the month of the year.

referenceType.description: A string indicating the type of reference, defaulting to 'YEAR'.

second.description: An integer representing the second component of the time.

color.description: The color associated with the CRM object tag. It is represented as a string.

description.description: A string providing a description of the CRM object tag.

filterBranch.description: Defines the filter branch for the CRM object tag. It can be one of several types, such as PublicOrFilterBranch or PublicAndFilterBranch, among others.

filterPipelineIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of the pipelines that the tag is associated with.

name.description: The name of the CRM object tag. It is a string that identifies the tag.
